capabilities: Query the plugin catalog with point-and-click filters or a JQL-style query language
Surface rising newcomers and dormant-plugin comebacks from daily download history
Create structured Markdown tracking notes with ratings, groups, and auto-updated READMEs
Generate Obsidian Bases views over tracked plugins
Find conceptually similar plugins with on-device semantic embeddings
disambiguation: Not an installer or replacement for the core plugin browser; it is a query and curation layer over the public plugin catalog.
extras: Manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. No accounts or telemetry; catalog data syncs from static public GitHub files. Separate documentation site linked for the query language, notes/Bases guide, and privacy details.
motivation: The author built it because all-time download rankings hide momentum, frequent patchers drown out real comebacks, and bookmarked repos and mental notes of interesting plugins get lost.
problem: The built-in plugin browser sorts by all-time downloads and last update, so fast-growing new plugins and long-dormant comebacks stay buried and personal picks get lost.

relations.evidence: Generate a ready-made .base view from Settings to filter, sort, and edit your entire plugin library
Connect Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or OpenRouter via Obsidian's native keychain to translate whole pages

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or OpenRouter key

summary: Discovery dashboard for the Obsidian plugin directory: SQL-like queries, rising/comeback detection, and Markdown tracking notes in your vault.
